deviations.figure: Coupling zz, edge by edge: shift of an idle qubit when one neighbour changes state
deviations.ibm_states: 11.6 to 58.8 kHz, median 28.3 (37 pairs); three more stated 0.00
deviations.delivered: Two runs on the same pairs, fixed before each job. Beat beside a superposed neighbour: median 12.9 kHz, slope on stated 0.19 [0.01, 0.38]. Shift, neighbour 0 then 1: 0.49 [0.45, 0.53] of stated, slope −0.06 [−0.63, 0.32] (0.19 [0.04, 0.37] without qubit 41’s two slipped fits)
deviations.deviation: Stated zz does not predict the coupling (slope 0.38 or less in both runs; a convention factor leaves it near 1)
deviations.how: One chip. Same code on fez: slopes 1.00 [0.89, 1.14] and 0.92 [0.83, 1.02]. A weak dependence remains (beat rank correlation 0.39 [0.05, 0.66]). Cause not identified
deviations.ibm_doc: “Unfortunately, unwanted interactions between qubits can lead to coherent errors on idling qubits.” (IBM, error mitigation guide); no zz figure is documented

deviations.deviation: Stated zero on 14 qubits in one session; delivered above what a zero allows on 9 to 11 of them.
deviations.how: Same evening, 3.9 h after IBM’s measurement; isolated and all-qubit reads agree (difference −0.0024 [−0.0048, +0.0001]); every qubit on the chip read, 20,000 shots per state. Fez: 1 of 2 stated zeros above; kingston: 0 of 1

record_notes.shows: where readout_error and both parts carry one date (3,766 measurements) it is exactly their average; on 153 measurements (43 qubits) it is not, and in every one the published prob_meas0_prep1 is older than the readout_error it should average into, by up to 97.5 h (18 off by more than 0.01, largest 0.157). 141 of the 153 are on qubits 16, 33, 50, … (every 17th). effects.effect: Phase kick on untouched qubits per mid-circuit readout
effects.ibm_states: no field in the calibration record
effects.delivered: fez −1.62 [−2.08, −1.18], kingston −2.86 [−3.55, −2.09], marrakesh −2.39 [−3.00, −1.72] degrees per readout (sizes 1.6 to 2.9); with 10 of the 39 read out, fez −0.17 [−0.32, −0.07] (22 Oct repeat, both copies)
effects.how: 39 of 156 read out, every untouched qubit within two couplings of a measured one; against an idle of the stated readout length, same job, two copies; default measure instruction (measure_2: marrakesh 0.51 to 0.58 of it; kingston 0.95 [0.75, 1.17] and 0.98 [0.77, 1.28] at 4 and 8 readouts, repeat, length ratio 0.63 excluded; fez cannot tell); repeated 22 Oct in the echo run’s no-echo arms (−1.50, −3.24, −2.50); qubits whose idle phase turns the other way are kicked the same way

effects.effect: Coherence lost by untouched qubits next to a measured one, 4 and 8 readouts
effects.ibm_states: no field in the calibration record
effects.delivered: kingston +0.0056 and +0.0062; marrakesh +0.0087 and +0.0205 (all above zero with copies pooled; kingston at 4 readouts: neither copy alone resolves it); fez cannot tell at 2 readouts under the committed rule and is consistent with zero at 4 and 8
effects.how: Only shots where every measured neighbour was verified in its |0⟩ cluster on every readout (97 to 99 % of shots); a neighbour left in a level that reads as 0 is excluded by an X-flip check on marrakesh, to the extent the flip catches it; neighbours excited and misread as 0 (0.4 to 1.1 % of shots stuck in |1⟩) are not excluded as the whole cost

effects.effect: Entanglement lost by untouched Bell pairs, 4 readouts
effects.ibm_states: no field in the calibration record
effects.delivered: Clean-shot loss: fez 0.0070 [0.0016, 0.0152], repeat 0.0051 [0.0005, 0.0126]; marrakesh 0.0093 [0.0005, 0.0155], repeat 0.0094 [0.0037, 0.0243]; kingston 0.0100 and, repeat, 0.0068 on clean shots (cannot tell under the committed rule), above zero on all shots in both. 39-readout minus 1-readout difference (the unbiased reading), 21 Oct: marrakesh 0.0088, kingston 0.0104, fez 0.0065 (cannot tell under the committed rule); repeat: above zero on kingston and marrakesh, consistent with zero on fez
effects.how: Readout against equal idle, same job, two independent runs never pooled; keeping only shots with every measured neighbour verified in |0⟩ can bias the loss upward, which the 39-minus-1 difference removes; in the control run’s selection marrakesh is consistent with zero at 2 and 4 readouts (+0.0060, +0.0056), while fez reads +0.004 at 4 and kingston +0.010 and +0.009 at 2 and 4, above zero

effects.ibm_states: no field in the calibration record
effects.delivered: marrakesh q8, 22 Oct: +0.049 to +0.081 (±0.010) in three circuit variants; the standard noise model built from the calibration at firing gives +0.003 to +0.005, and q8’s stated readout asymmetry accounts for +0.006; fez 11 Oct +0.062; 24 Sep +0.060, the mean of four jobs on marrakesh, kingston and fez
effects.how: Post-selected probe in the box whose ideal value is 0; the model is built from IBM’s calibration, not a figure IBM states. Probe split, 22 Oct: probe readout and state preparation consistent with zero on fez and marrakesh; the part carried by the controlled gate lies within what the stated CZ error allows if that error is coherent. Readout-corrected offsets stay above zero. Cause not identified

effects.ibm_states: one T1 per qubit, a single-exponential fit
effects.delivered: 62 to 85 % of qubit-copies prepared in |1⟩ read below the line from their own 300 µs level at 30 µs (26 jobs, 4 to 7 October), where a pure exponential gives 49 to 54 %
effects.how: All qubits prepared in |1⟩, read at 30 to 600 µs in one job; the job’s own |0⟩ and |1⟩ circuits remove readout error. The test cannot separate a non-exponential decay from a per-qubit systematic common to the three copies; the data do not identify the cause

method: Method: same quantity, same definition, against IBM’s calibration record saved when the job ran. Medians over qubits, 95 % intervals; a deviation is listed only when IBM’s figure falls outside our interval. Data and scripts: heuremen.org/experiments · doi:10.5281/zenodo.23169755.
